newsitem.title: CHINA: WHEELOCK OFFERS FLATS AT DISCOUNT.
newsitem.headline: WHEELOCK OFFERS FLATS AT DISCOUNT.

text.p: Wheelock and Co Ltd's property arm Wheelock Properties Ltd said on Thursday it would offer residential flats in Kowloon's Hunghom at a price lower than the the second-hand transaction prices in the area.

The company said the last batch of 28 units in Bailey Garden would be offered at an average price of HK$6,450 a square foot, below the highest second-hand prices of HK$10,000 a square foot in Hunghom and an average of HK$7,000 in New Territories.
"We are trying to attract more potential end-users to buy the flats by offering the units at an attractive discount," a company spokeswoman said.
The flats, ranging from 600 to 611 square feet, will go on sale on Saturday on a first-come-first-served basis, the company said.
Bailey Garden is composed of 432 units in two 31-storey towers, of which more than 90 percent of the flats have been sold, it said.
